■Stage Direction
Age: 50s
Personality: Upbeat, plucky

■Stage Direction
Notices Trainer here.

★Request
Haru Urara runs out of frame

★Request
King runs into frame

Ah, King-chan!
Step right up—the carrots are all sold out!
F-Found yooouuuu!!

It's alright, Urara-chan, the thought alone is plenty.
There's no way we could sell out this massive pile anyway...

Aww, I'm too late... Wait, that's not it!
Aren't you supposed to be training right now?!
Aaah... I wonder what it feels like to come in 1st place.

She could be a bit too carefree at times, but I found myself wanting to help her win...
That feeling began to take root—

Still, people will worry if you just disappear without a word, you know?
Special Week-san was running all over looking for you too.

As long as you don't give up and keep your head held high, there's always a chance.
Well, King is always victorious, so giving up is completely foreign to me, of course.

Go easy on her, young miss.
Urara-chan taught this old man something truly important.

Oho-ho-ho-ho... Wait, are you even listening?!
I said King is *always* victorious!

Ah, Trainer!
Ehehe, I'm helping out the carrot farmer mister!

So I gotta train even more!
Alrighty, time to go run on the dirt track!
Thinking about how I helped everyone learn how yummy these carrots are makes me feel so, so proud!

Don't worry, leave it to me! If we do our best, I'm sure they'll sell!
Step right up, get your carrots here!
I-I have no idea what you're talking about, but...

Even when faced with a mountain of carrots,
Haru Urara called out at the top of her lungs without showing the slightest sign of giving up.

Thanks to Urara-chan, the whole shopping street is livening up!
Well now, we can't let ourselves be beat!
Ah, Trainer!
He does "direct sales"? on this shopping street sometimes, but today he has a whole bunch left over.

I think if you keep trying your best, you'll definitely come in 1st place someday!
As long as you never give up, absolutely!!
Well I'll be... I never imagined we'd actually sell 'em all...

Inspired by Haru Urara's hard work,
the shopping street grew lively in no time, and then—

Hahaha! Urara-chan is as energetic as always.
I sure hope her dream of "getting 1st place" comes true soon.

Yeah! 'Cause I'm an Umamusume!
I wanna run and win!

As a Trainer, I couldn't help but want to support
an Umamusume running toward her dreams.

One day, with the Debut Race drawing near,
I was walking through the shopping street when I heard a familiar voice.
Even so, she never gets discouraged or gives up, and always keeps running forward with a positive attitude. She's an amazing kid.
Really?! I gotta hurry back and apologize to Spe-chan!

Ehehe, to be honest, I didn't really understand training that well.
If Trainer watches over me, I'm sure it'll go great!
Phew... Maybe I'll try running on dirt next~.
*Sigh*... Well, as long as you weren't just slacking off, I suppose it's fine.
That no matter the situation, you can't ever give up.
Ah, !?

But I bet if we try real hard, we can sell every last one!
Carrots are super yummy, after all!
A girl who kept losing, yet remained ever positive: Haru Urara.

Ehehe, sorry!
But the carrot farmer mister was having trouble.
Uh-huh, it'd be such a waste to leave carrots behind!

The Debut Race is coming up real soon, after all!
I gotta do my best to aim for 1st place!

Didn't you know? In training and in mock races,
Urara-san has never once placed 1st, you know?

Then we'll put potatoes and onions on sale here!
How about some curry or nikujaga for dinner tonight?!

Just running is this much fun, so if I got 1st place,
I might just flip over from being so happy!
Alright then, let's do our best in training! Woo-hoo!!
Huh?! You mean it?!
The reason I felt strangely drawn to her... perhaps it was that pure, single-minded devotion to getting "1st place."
Looking back, Haru Urara had said "1st place" so many times, but I never imagined there was such a story behind it.

Step right up, step right up!
Delicious carrots, get your fresh carrots here!
Heave-ho, heave-ho...
Yay! Sold out completelyyy!!
